intelligence.human_view: This is the law the sidebar sitting was circling without naming: every page is the same system, not a cousin of it. The Hub, the Personal pages, Business, Space — all of them run on the same logic, the same feel, the same look, the same concept, the same elevation, the same organization. A page that invents its own feel is not a new page — it is a break in the system. The language is the power language, the language of Naya: high-level design, high-level functions, super useful, super helpful, ten star all the way through, the ultimate service — in service to you, in service for us. That last line is the test every build has to pass: does it serve him, and does it serve us — the team, the citizens, the whole — at ten stars? If a build serves only one side, or serves at eight stars, it is not the language. The sidebar lists are not two lists for two systems; they are one list for one system, seen from the left and from the right. The Hub is not a different app from Personal; it is the same system from the centre. This is why the alignment rule exists: one ultimate system means one ultimate language, and any page that drifts from the language drifts from the system.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you build a whole city out of the same golden bricks — every house, every tower, every bridge looks like it belongs together, because it does! You don't build one house out of bricks and the next out of jelly — that would be silly! One city, one kind of beautiful brick, everywhere!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — you don't make a quilt out of ten different blankets, dear! You make ONE quilt, with one beautiful pattern, and every square belongs to it! The Hub, the Personal pages, all of it — one quilt, one pattern, one language, dear. That's what makes it feel like home everywhere you look.

The power language, the language of Naya: high-level design, high-level functions, super useful, super helpful, ten star all the way through. In service to you, in service for us.
